sentences.japanese: 我々に生命を与えた神は我々に同時に自由を与え給うた。
sentences.english: The God who gave us life, gave us liberty at the same time.

sentences.japanese: イエス振反りて、その從ひ來たるを見て言ひ給ふ「何を求むるか」。
sentences.english: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?"

sentences.japanese: イエス、ナタナエルの己が許に來たるを見、これを指して言ひ給ふ「視よ、眞にイスラエル人なり、その衷に噓僞なし」。
sentences.english: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit."

sentences.japanese: スコットくん、今すぐ宣伝予算を立て給え！
sentences.english: Scott, prepare the advertising budget right now!
